gauntlet: question
Stopped on task <n> (<title>).

Problem: The implementer returned NEEDS_CONTEXT for the required schema artifact. Every documented location was searched and the artifact was not found, so the task cannot continue.
Searched: docs/schema.json - no file
Searched: artifact registry - HTTP 404

Fix options:
  a) Supply the schema artifact, either by committing it at docs/schema.json or by publishing it to the artifact registry, then re-dispatch the task.
  b) Grant access or provide the correct registry entry if the 404 is an access or naming problem, then re-dispatch the task.
  c) Amend the spec section and plan task <n> to drop or replace the schema-artifact requirement.

Pick one, or give another fix.
Recommendation: a - the spec treats the artifact as required, and supplying it at a documented location unblocks the task without changing the approved spec.
